page.layout: One block of verse at the top, full width, indented lines; below it a woodcut ornament, centred; at lower right the word LIBER.

main_text.p: Quid his merenti grata laboribus Mercedis ætas postera seu fluens Compensét? aut quæ fortis Heros Præmia digna tibi reponat? Ad me quod optantem attinet, imprecor, Non solum ut ipsum, verùm etiam tuos Cum Sole, cum Lunâ, libellos Vivida perpetuet Perenna.
main_text.head: LIBER

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a triangular frame with a putto and a face) between the verse and LIBER, not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The verse is set in italic; the printed words are transcribed as they stand. The accent on "Compensét" and the mark over "verùm" are read from the scan and may be a printer's accent or a worn stroke. The accent on "Lunâ" is printed as a circumflex.
